title: 10 Best Things to Do in Mechelen
description: The best things to do in Mechelen, Belgium — curated from Reddit. A guide to the top attractions, from St. Rumbold's Tower to the Het Anker brewery.

places.name: St. Rumbold's Tower
places.verdict: The single best way to get your bearings and appreciate the beauty of Mechelen.

comparison.strengths: Known for skywalk · Historic Landmark · Mechelen
comparison.why it made the list: The single best way to get your bearings and appreciate the beauty of Mechelen. The climb is manageable and the reward is a breathtaking 360° view. Don't miss it.

places.insiderTip: The single best way to get your bearings and appreciate the beauty of Mechelen. The climb is manageable and the reward is a breathtaking 360° view. Don't miss it.

places.name: Grote Markt
places.verdict: The perfect place to start or end your day.

comparison.best for: people-watching with a Belgian beer in hand
comparison.why it made the list: The perfect place to start or end your day. It’s picturesque, full of life, and ideal for people-watching with a Belgian beer in hand.

places.name: Het Anker Brewery
places.verdict: An essential pilgrimage for any beer lover.

comparison.why it made the list: An essential pilgrimage for any beer lover. The tour is informative, the history is fascinating, and the beer is magnificent. The brasserie on site also serves excellent food.

places.insiderTip: An essential pilgrimage for any beer lover. The tour is informative, the history is fascinating, and the beer is magnificent. The brasserie on site also serves excellent food.

places.name: Kazerne Dossin

comparison.why it made the list: A somber but essential visit. Kazerne Dossin confronts a dark chapter of history with grace and power, connecting the past to contemporary issues of human rights.

places.name: TOY Museum
places.verdict: A delightful and surprisingly engaging museum.

comparison.why it made the list: A delightful and surprisingly engaging museum. Whether you’re a kid or just a kid at heart, the sheer breadth of the collection is impressive and guaranteed to bring a smile to your face.

places.name: HOF VAN Busleyden
places.verdict: A must-see for history and art buffs.

comparison.strengths: Known for skywalk · City Museum · Mechelen
comparison.why it made the list: A must-see for history and art buffs. The museum offers a fascinating glimpse into the period when Mechelen was a center of power and culture in Europe.

places.name: Mechels Broek
places.verdict: The perfect complement to a day of city sightseeing.
